note: Both sets capture the core elevations, identifiers and cladding/handrail specs, and both repeat the same unsupported claim that the PV array sits between grid lines 4 and 6 plus an invented 'roof/overhang' binding. Set B adds several correct, distinct facts Set A misses (APSE-20 tube model, powdercoated steel flatbar railing posts, West Elevation scale 1/4"=1'-0", the note that tube-array spacing may be larger, and identifiers W1 1.01 and W2 1.04). Set A does capture facts B omits (40 tubes, 1/8" cable diameter, A-511 Hardie reference, W5 1.14), but it pads the set with near-duplicate claims and a trivial 'PV SOLAR ARRAY presence: installed' claim whose quote does not support it. Net, B is slightly more faithful and less redundant.
